verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a public web API for managing organizations, teams, and data programmatically (sentry-docs-14/20), plus an official MCP server enabling AI assistants to search errors, analyze performance, and manage projects (sentry-docs-2, sentry-probe-3), and a CLI for scripted access (sentry-probe-4). Together these give AI-native users multiple documented, programmatic ways to drive the product. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (sentry-probe-2 shows 404s) and no independent hands-on corroboration of API robustness.
